media.researchFrames: Desktop uniform 4:5 white canvases contain full source images; mobile returns to intrinsic proportions. This is CSS presentation only, with no raster changes.

layout.outer: One layout-owned article capped at 720px plus a 144px rail/48px gap gives maximum 912px outer width. Through 1100px, 112px rail/32px gap gives maximum 864px outer width. Desktop/narrow minimum side gutters are 48px/32px; through 760px use the existing disclosure and 20px side gutters.
layout.alignment: All five chapters share both article edges: headings, prose, standalone images, and group wrappers fill the column. No descendant 720px/760px/800px caps or section-2 special cap. Internal group columns are preserved; caption text stays centered within its full figure width.
layout.media: Original proportions; 16px in-page corners, 12px mobile. Image captions centered; video caption is a title/link row.
layout.groups: Research pair: two equal 4:5 white frames with 24px gap and 12px inner padding, 348px × 435px each at the full 720px measure; complete originals use object-fit contain. Through 760px, stack with auto frame ratio, zero padding and original image proportions. Storyboard stacks through 760px; mode and interaction pairs stack through 1100px. Afterword principles are ordinary paragraphs with inline source bold and no columns.
layout.hero: The desktop Hero places the cover on the left and the two-line title/question and introduction on the right, using equal columns with a 56px gap. The artwork spans both text rows and centers vertically. A full-width metadata row sits below both columns. Row gaps are 28px, with 12px additional space before metadata. Through 1100px the column gap is 40px. Through 760px, the single-column order is title/question → cover → introduction → metadata with a 32px gap and no extra metadata margin. Hero top/bottom padding is 72px/80px on desktop and 40px/48px on mobile.
layout.heroFacts: Hero metadata spans the full composition below the cover and text in three columns: 时间—2025, 项目类型—硕士毕业设计, and 关键词—#AI #交互范式 #能动性. The duration field is omitted at the user’s request. A 1px theme-rule line separates this row from the main composition, with 28px padding above its content. Labels are muted 13px/500 with 8px below; values are 16px. Only non-clickable keyword spans use 13px text, 1px theme-rule borders, pill corners and 3px/10px padding. Desktop columns are equal with 32px gaps; mobile keeps three columns in 0.6fr:1.2fr:1.5fr proportions, 16px gaps and 24px top padding. Whole keyword chips wrap without reducing type. The user-approved field list is a webpage presentation override; Obsidian remains unchanged.
layout.challenge: The callout fills the article. Its h3, quote, and figure share the same padded inner box: 32px horizontal inset desktop, 20px mobile. No independent image cap or auto-centering.

video.placement: After the hero and introduction, before the chapter layout.
video.controls: Vimeo playback controls, inline playback, fullscreen, lazy loading and an external fallback link.
video.logo: The embed requests vimeo_logo=0 with other hide-chrome parameters. The build thread observed the logo still visible; logo removal is not a hard requirement or guaranteed behavior.

components.name: Chapter navigation
components.description: Vertical desktop rail with an ink-colored active label and left marker; mobile is a disclosure.
components.html: 问题洞察设计原则概念框架后记 · 写于 2026
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:144px;border-left:1px solid var(--query-rule,#dadfdc);font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),"PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB",sans-serif;}.ds-nav a{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:10px 0 10px 16px;color:var(--query-muted,#697069);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;transition:color 180ms ease,transform 120ms ease;}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--query-ink,#242723);font-weight:500;}.ds-nav a[aria-current]::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1px;inset-block:12px;width:2px;background:currentColor;}.ds-nav a:active{transform:translateX(2px);}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--query-ink,#242723);}}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--query-blue,#154bc0);outline-offset:6px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none;}}

narrative.northStar: Original artifacts on a quiet reading surface
narrative.overview:
This records only /projects/from-query-to-quest. Its visual authority is app/query-case.css and the current Query case components. Incumbent landing, shared site chrome, and other project pages keep their existing visual rules.

A unified sans-serif hierarchy, common left alignment, and generous paragraph rhythm frame the original blue/lilac artwork. Desktop chapters sit beside a quiet left directory; mobile exposes that directory through a compact disclosure. The page varies density with source-based image and text groupings.
keyCharacteristics: Geist/PingFang headings and prose with a shared content left edge.
Source headings split into a smaller label and a larger main sentence.
Original media with rounded presentation and centered gray captions; all case images are static and non-clickable.
Desktop chapter rail and mobile collapsible chapter navigation.

rules.name: The Legible Selection Rule
rules.body: Keep the explicit selection foreground/background pair in both themes. Increased-contrast preferences promote body and muted text to theme ink.

rules.name: The Source Heading Rule
rules.body: Split each original h2 at its Chinese colon: the prefix becomes the small label and the remaining sentence becomes the main title. Keep both inside one semantic h2; keep the colon available to assistive technology while hiding it visually. This is the user's explicit request for source-derived labels, not permission to invent extra editorial labels.

rules.name: The Shared Body Rule
rules.body: Every afterword principle is an ordinary source paragraph at the 720px reading measure, using the same 18px desktop/17px mobile body scale as surrounding paragraphs. Its source strong opening remains inline. The three-column, compact-body, and enlarged opening/closing treatments are removed.

rules.name: The Shared Width Rule
rules.body: One article width controls all five chapters. Chapter headings, prose, standalone images, and group wrappers fill that column and share both left and right edges. Descendants have no independent 720px, 760px, or 800px caps. Figure captions center their text within their own full-width figure; grouped text/image units keep their existing internal columns.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Fine borders and the challenge tint create structure without case shadows or blurred navigation. Mobile navigation has an opaque theme ground.

rules.name: The Visible Before Motion Rule
rules.body: Chapter headings remain visible before JavaScript. Their one-time entry moves 14px to rest and changes opacity from 0.55 to 1 over 560ms with cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1). Reduced motion skips or cancels this entry and disables case transitions. Focus uses a 2px blue outline with 6px offset.

dos: **Do** align all five chapters' headings, prose, standalone images, and group wrappers to the same article edges.
**Do** keep source-derived heading labels faithful to the current Markdown and Hero metadata faithful to the user-approved field list.
**Do** preserve original image bytes, proportions, alt text, and captions.
**Do** keep images non-clickable while preserving chapter keyboard navigation and reduced-motion support.
**Do** retain the external Vimeo playback link.
donts: **Don't** apply this case-specific system to landing or other project routes automatically.
**Don't** restore the removed serif hierarchy, centered prose, afterword columns, or enlarged afterword opening/closing treatment.
**Don't** publish the editorial workspace, invent case copy, or modify the source Markdown.
**Don't** embed provenance into the rasters; keep it in the generated JSON snapshot.
**Don't** promise that embed parameters remove Vimeo's logo when the player still shows it.
